smoke.seededThrough: public import/exact fonts/Family and Studio saveTemplate

decision.recommendation: Propose a separate bounded F7 ownership and implementation plan: 14–15 unchanged derivations repeatedly execute before the editor mount request, and all 15 precede readiness. No implementation or speedup is authorized by this packet.
decision.caveat: The trace establishes synchronous work in the mount/readiness sequence, not the eventual counterfactual saving. Media derivations do not overlap recorded >50 ms long tasks in this run. Cold/warm differences include decoding and renderer/font settlement; a separate ownership plan and minimally instrumented before/after pairs remain mandatory.

limitations: Five finite paired observations per case; p95 of five trials is descriptive, not a reliable tail distribution.
Fresh contexts are decode/session cold; browser process and OS caches are not cold-start certification.
Detailed and minimal runs use the identical production runtime; differences measure observation overhead and variability.
Native ready publication, observed stable DOM and PNG completion are separate overlapping intervals.
Full application smoke uses a Family seeded through public import/font/Family/save APIs; it is not a manual picker or full setup-wizard review.
